verdict.rationale: Slack has a documented Web API reference (e.g. chat.postMessage method docs) and a separate official OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec repo, plus a keyless api.test endpoint that can be hit directly, showing some API exploration surface. However, there is no evidence of an interactive in-docs 'try it' console with runnable examples embedded in docs.slack.dev itself (openapi.json probes 404 on the docs site), so the 'interactive reference' claim is only partially supported. Missing for 10: an in-browser runnable API console, live code-example execution within docs.slack.dev, and independent confirmation of interactivity.
